discussion.body:
Separate log: Forge-King Vortan (Constium / World Cannon). Face two of three. Living appearance hides undeath.
Copied living plates, not reuploaded. New undead study generated from the accepted living build (same short heavy forge-king body, gray beard, tank and shorts). Undead tells: ash skin, ember-glass stare, dry hair, stitch-cracks at joints and belly. Not a skeleton. Not Nyxara.
Locals: artifacts/Concept art/FEAT-002-vortan-build-study.jpg, FEAT-002-vortan-undead-study.jpg. Existing clothed plate stays. No status change. HEAD not moved.
